//: Composite indexes for the compound queries in FirestoreService.list_all. Firestore auto-creates single-field indexes, but a query combining several filters (especially an inequality such as stock > 0) needs an explicit composite index. Deploy with: gcloud firestore indexes create --index-file=deployment/firestore.indexes.json  (or `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`). Without these, _stream() logs 'MISSING FIRESTORE INDEX' and falls back to a full collection scan, which still answers correctly but reads every tenant's documents.
//businesses: GET /api/businesses filters on owner_uid alone. That needs no entry here: Firestore indexes every single field automatically, and declaring one as a composite index is rejected outright -- 'this index is not necessary, configure using single field index controls' -- which fails the whole deploy, not just that entry.
